title: West Pakistan Highways Sindh Amendment Act 2018

sections.shortTitle: West Pakistan Highways Sindh Amendment Act 2018
sections.description:
Short title and commencement

ACT XII OF 2018
ACT XII OF 2018
WEST PAKISTAN HIGHWAYS
(SINDH AMENDMENT) ACT, 2018.
An Act to amend the West Pakistan Highways Ordinance, 1959, in its
application to the Province of Sindh
[Gazette of Sindh Extraordinary, Part IV, 9th May, 2018]
NO.
PAS/LEGIS-B-12/2018, dated 9.5.2018.---The West Pakistan Highways (Sindh Amendment) Bill, 2018 having been
passed by the Provincial Assembly of Sindh on 13th April, 2018 and assented to
by the Governor of Sindh on 04th May, 2018 is hereby published as an Act of the
Legislature of Sindh.
Preamble.---WHEREAS it is expedient to amend the West
Pakistan Highways Ordinance, 1959, in its application to the Province of Sindh,
in the manner hereinafter appearing:
It
is hereby enacted as follows:-
1. Short
title and commencement.---(1) This
Act may be called the West Pakistan Highways (Sindh Amendment) Act, 2018.
(2) It
shall come into force at once.
